The court record MUST state that the PDL is a recidivist/habitual delinquent/escapee, had previously been convicted twice, failed to voluntarily surrender to summons, or the judge acknowledges that the crime charged is a heinous crime.\n\nIf the court record does not show any of these or you do not know the content of the court record, DO NOT TICK THIS BOX.
